housing.name: Family Home
housing.description: Stay in the spare room. It is financially safe, but privacy is limited.

mining.reason: The household will not allow mining equipment.

housing.tradeoff: Lowest cost; limited privacy and no mining space.
housing.benefit: Lowest cost • Supportive household • No mining space

housing.name: Rented Room
housing.description: A lockable room in a shared townhouse with predictable bills.

mining.reason: The circuit can safely support one compact rig.

housing.tradeoff: Affordable independence; shared facilities and space for one compact rig.
housing.benefit: More independence • One compact mining rig allowed

housing.name: City Apartment
housing.description: A private one-bedroom near work, nightlife, and transit.

mining.reason: Dedicated power and ventilation support two compact rigs.

housing.tradeoff: Best privacy and wellbeing; high monthly cost and deposit.
housing.benefit: Private space • Better wellbeing • Two compact rigs allowed
